title: LLV-GBANK300Q25C: compact quantum bank at the quarter-source full-log envelope

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GBANK300Q25C interpreter of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^(sqrt(n)log2(n)+(17/8)sqrt(n)+2sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(-1/2))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. The selected complete virtual program is LLV-GFL300Q25 with its exact quarter-source profile, original guards, partial finishing calls, failed work, all-modulus decoders and finite branch preserved. The actual compact full-vector/two-label-root packing, fixed maximal region addresses, every bank bit/field/address operation, coherent control, source SWAP, initialization and cleanup is charged. Its sharper internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)+(17/8)sqrt(n)+O(sqrt(n)/logn)+O((logn)^2) has strict eventual slack absorbing the entire fixed polynomial bank overhead into the exact stated envelope. All five claims concern this one physical implementation.

For the same physical LLV-GBANK300Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated classical space is O(n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. It includes N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staging operands, complete short address/scan fields and finite controller code. All other labels, arrays, frames, return contexts, numeric loop/cap counters, arithmetic, generator and allocation metadata are in the counted basis-qubit bank, not a duplicate classical stack or measurement transcript. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK300Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum workspace is O(n^3/log2n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. For ell=max(1,ceil log2n),E=2^ell,J=max(1,ceil(E/ell)), seven fixed regions each C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2)))*J bits, C=2^48, bound the full classical-virtual address span. A full-vector pool of2^20ceil(n/ell) slots of16nE bits covers all retained full tables; final two-label roots have a separate pool of2^17n slots of16n bits. Tuple/input/source/decoder/arithmetic and all allocation metadata fit the same explicit capacities. Original logical quantum slots span O(n), with bank-resident ID lists. Every physical bank qubit, unused paired-prefix padding, coherent register, source temporary, failure, growth and cleanup counts. All address fees are charged. Section3 proves actual fixed maximum spans and slot reuse, not just live occupancy. With J=O(n/logn), the complete prefix is O(n^3/logn), jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK300Q25C algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired source copies number O(2^((1/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Exact CQ/source-channel simulation executes one physical request per virtual request and no others, including every failed/discarded EXTRACT, fallback, rejected and aborted acquisition. Local zero bank/padding preparations count as time and quantum storage, not source copies. Complete virtual Section8 proves the literal main nCcap+K<=2^(sqrt(n)/4); finite lengths change only outside constants. The actual request sequence and output law are preserved under independent ideal copies, giving unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 jointly with all resource/error claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANK300Q25C algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N and secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and the entire secret is recovered with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The CQ simulation permits classical correlations between bank values and coherent registers but proves no transfer to an adaptive malformed supplier that observes extra bank measurements. No positive tolerance or impossibility of greater robustness is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
